production.direction_en: A twig snaps above the road. Nixie drops from a low branch, bow already drawn at the shadow behind the party.
production.music_direction_en: pre: silence until the twig snaps, then bgm_tension | post: bgm_warmth (party of five is complete)

commands.speaker: nixie_vale
commands.text: I was going to Oakhaven anyway. I will take the rear watch.

commands.speaker: fadyme
commands.text: You do not have to stay with us.

commands.speaker: nixie_vale
commands.text: I know. That is why I can choose to.

commands.speaker: narration
commands.text: Nixie joins permanently. The company now has five owned heroes: Mahmut, Fadyme, Brin, Nixie and the companion chosen by invitation.
